name: 🕸Jamie Greaves🕸
bio:
Jamie Greaves is a masterful tattoo artist based in Leicester, UK, whose artistic wheelhouse extends to both traditional and neo-traditional styles. Known for his exceptional skills in creating unique, high-quality tattoos, he taps into his keen eye for detail and artistic flair at Real Art Tattoo studio, as well as at House of Thieves Tattoo, where he is a monthly guest artist. With an unwaveringly high standard of professionalism, Jamie ensures a seamless booking process through both email and direct messaging.
